description: This file defines the interface for a text-based commit graph API, including functions to initialize, update, and render a commit graph, as well as configuration options for colors and line prefixes.

methods.name: graph_setup_line_prefix
methods.description: Sets up global display options for diff line prefixes to ensure consistent graph display.

methods.name: graph_set_column_colors
methods.description: Configures custom ANSI or HTML color schemes for graph columns.

methods.name: graph_init
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new git_graph structure based on given revision info.

methods.name: graph_clear
methods.description: Frees resources allocated for a git_graph structure.

methods.name: graph_update
methods.description: Updates the graph state with a new commit, preparing for subsequent line output.

methods.name: graph_is_commit_finished
methods.description: Checks if all lines for the current commit have been output.

methods.name: graph_next_line
methods.description: Outputs the next line of the graph into a strbuf; indicates whether the current commit is included.

methods.name: graph_width
methods.description: Returns the current width of the graph in characters.

methods.name: graph_show_commit
methods.description: Prints the current commit's graph representation.

methods.name: graph_show_oneline
methods.description: Prints one line of the graph.

methods.name: graph_show_padding
methods.description: Prints vertical padding for the graph.

methods.name: graph_show_remainder
methods.description: Prints the remaining part of the graph for the current commit.

methods.name: graph_show_commit_msg
methods.description: Displays commit message alongside the graph lines.
